title: Pepper OS — Detailed User Guide
subtitle: How to use the platform, by role

intro.what: Pepper OS is the single operating system for the Customer Experience (CX) org. It replaces spreadsheets and Slack threads with one source of truth for every active customer deal — who owns it, how it's staffed, how healthy it is, whether the MBR has been done, and how the financials are tracking.
navigation: Your personal landing page — pinned deals, your open tasks, quick links.
Every client and the deals under them. The deepest module in the product — click any deal to open the 7-tab Deal Detail.
Two views: Deal view (who's on each deal) and People view (every person's allocations). Add, lock, and rebalance staffing here.
Hierarchical org tree, roles, capability membership, hiring requests, leavers.
Red/Yellow/Green tracker across 8 health dimensions for every deal. The board, table, and insights tabs.
Monthly Business Reviews — schedule, notes, compliance warnings.
Personal preferences, Users & Roles, Access Controls, Integrations.
common: Press Cmd+K (Mac) or Ctrl+K (Windows) anywhere to jump to a deal, person, or page.
Toggle Dark / Light in the top bar — your choice is remembered per device.
Almost every cell in the product is editable in place. Click a value, type, press Enter. No 'Save' button required.
Switch INR / USD in the top bar. All amounts re-render with FX conversion using the rate set in Settings -> Integrations.
If you see an amber banner at the top of a page, your role can view but not edit that section. Hover the badges in any table to see exactly which fields are locked.

personas.name: Admin / Central CX
personas.summary: You run the platform. Full edit access to every module, every deal, every person. You're also the gatekeeper for staffing locks and access control.
daily: Start the day on the Home dashboard. Scan KPI tiles: Red deals, MBR overdue, staffing < 60% utilised, receivables aging > 60 days.
Open RGY Health -> Health Board -> 'All' VSD filter. Any deal in the Red column is your priority list for the morning.
Jump into Staffing & Capacity -> People view. Look for red bars (under 60%) and yellow bars (over 85%) — these need rebalancing.
MBR Tracker: confirm anything marked 'Overdue' for the current month has either been scheduled or escalated.

modules.name: Clients & Deals
steps: Click 'New Client' (top right) to open the creation wizard. Step 1: client basics. Step 2: first deal under that client.
On an existing deal, the Overview tab is your single edit pane: Account, MRR, Start/End, Status, VSD, Principal/Senior/BOPM dropdowns.
Use the trash icon to soft-delete a deal — it's recoverable from the Trash page for 30 days, then purged.
Bulk operations: from the Clients table, select multiple rows to bulk-tag pod or VSD.

modules.name: Staffing & Capacity
steps: Open any deal's staffing card. Click the amber 'Unstaffed' chip to lock the deal as 'Staffed' — only admins can do this. Locked deals can't be edited until you unlock.
Click 'Add Staffing' on a deal to assign a person + role + allocation %. The system warns if the person is already > 100% allocated.
Use the People view to spot capacity issues. Red = <60%, Green = 60–85%, Yellow = >85% (over-allocated).
BOPMs can raise staffing requests; you approve them in the Approval Requests drawer (bell icon, top bar).

modules.name: RGY Health
steps: Click any RGY cell in the Table tab to change a dimension. Marking a deal Green forces you through the 'Green-gate' validator: all 8 dimensions must justify Green.
Use the Insights tab for VSD- and pod-level rollups. Drill-downs are clickable.
Pending KPI tile shows deals that have never been marked — these need a VSD assigned and a first review.

modules.name: Settings -> Users & Roles
steps: Add a user by email. They sign in via Google SSO; the first sign-in creates their profile and links to their staffing record by email match.
Assign role: Admin, VSD, BOPM, Capability Leader, Capability Member, or Viewer.
Use 'View As' to preview the product as any role — useful before changing access policies.

modules.name: Settings -> Access Controls
steps: Per route, per role: toggle visibility and configure view/edit scope tokens (e.g. 'Own pod only', 'Edit financials').
Defaults are sensible — only override when a specific persona needs an exception.

cans: Edit every field on every deal
Edit access controls and FX rate
faq: A VSD says they can't see a deal they own.
Confirm the deal's `vsd` column matches their full name exactly. Email mismatch breaks the profile<->staffing link.
A BOPM is on staffing but can't open the deal.
BOPM access is granted via the deal's BOPM cells, NOT staffing_assignments. Add their name to principal_bopm / senior_bopm / bopm on the Overview tab.
The Pending RGY count looks too high.
Filter the RGY board by VSD = 'Unassigned' — these are deals waiting for VSD assignment in Settings -> People & Reporting.

personas.name: VSD (Vertical Service Director)
personas.summary: You own the P&L of your pod. The platform surfaces every deal where you are the VSD, plus deals where a Principal/Senior BOPM rolls up to you.
daily: Home dashboard: review the 'My Pod' KPI strip and pinned deals.
RGY Health -> filter by 'You' — anything Red or Yellow is your call to make this week.
MBR Tracker -> check compliance for the current month for your pod's deals.
Staffing & Capacity -> confirm Add Staffing requests raised by your BOPMs are approved within 24h.

modules.name: Clients & Deals (your scope)
steps: Open any deal in your pod. Use the Overview tab to keep MRR, contract dates, and BOPM assignments current.
Financials tab -> 6 sub-tabs. Edit Contracted MRR, Consumption, GM%, Invoiced, Received inline. Watch the receivables aging chip — anything > 60 days needs escalation.
Use the Contract Details panel to spot deals renewing in < 30 days (chip turns amber).

modules.name: Staffing
steps: Approve / decline staffing requests routed to you via the bell icon.
Spot under-utilisation in your pod — People view, filter by your pod, sort by allocation ascending.
Use the WeeklyStaffingGrid (bottom of every deal's Staffing tab) to plan the next 4 weeks at row-by-row hour level.

modules.name: RGY Health
steps: Mark RGY for any deal you own. Logging a Red requires a mandatory issue + action-plan form — this is non-negotiable.
Insights tab shows your pod ranked vs. peers. Aim for an Overall Health Score > 70/100.

modules.name: MBR Tracker
steps: Every deal in your pod must have one MBR per calendar month. The tracker warns 5 days before the end of the month.
Click into an MBR to upload the deck + meeting notes. The 'Single source of truth' field lets you mark this MBR as the canonical one for the month.

cans: Edit any deal in your pod (financials, RGY, staffing, MBR)
Approve staffing requests from your BOPMs
cants: Edit org-level targets or FX rate
faq: A deal disappeared from my list.
Its `Deal Status` was changed to Closed / Lost. Filter the Clients table by Status = All to see closed deals.
I marked a deal Green but the score didn't change.
Score recomputes when ≥ 4 of 8 dimensions are non-Pending. Mark the remaining dimensions explicitly.

personas.name: BOPM (Business Operations & Project Manager)
personas.summary: You run the day-to-day for the deals you're tagged on. Access is restricted to those deals only — you won't see anyone else's.
daily: Home -> My Tasks: Kanban of the 5-column board (Backlog, In Progress, Blocked, In Review, Done). Time-track on the fly.
Open each of your deals. Confirm staffing is locked (green 'Staffed' chip). If not, raise a request.
Update RGY for any dimension that changed this week.
If an MBR is due, schedule it from the MBR Tracker.

modules.name: Clients & Deals (your tagged deals only)
steps: Overview tab: keep the Team card current. If a designer or strategist changes, update their entry — this auto-creates a staffing assignment.
Tasks tab: drag cards across the 5-column board. Click into a card to log time, add subtasks, or attach files.
RGY tab: red/amber/green dimensions you've marked here flow up to the RGY Health module.

modules.name: Staffing
steps: You can't add staffing directly. Click 'Request Staffing' on any of your deals — it routes to the relevant Capability Leader, then to Central CX for approval.
Read-only views of allocations and capacity are available so you can plan.

modules.name: RGY Health
steps: Mark RGY only for the deals you're tagged on. Same Green-gate rules as VSDs apply.
Use the Table view for fast bulk updates across your portfolio.

modules.name: MBR Tracker
steps: Schedule, upload notes, and mark MBRs done for your deals.
Compliance warnings appear 5 days before month-end; act on them.

cans: View and edit deals you're tagged on (BOPM cell)
Edit RGY and MBR on your deals
cants: See deals you're not tagged on
Edit financials beyond your scope (admin policy)
faq: I'm staffed on a deal but can't see it.
BOPM scope is granted by deal sheet cells (principal_bopm / senior_bopm / bopm), not staffing assignments. Ask your VSD to add your name to one of those cells on the Overview tab.
My staffing request is stuck.
Bell icon -> Approval Requests shows status. Stage 1 is Capability Leader, Stage 2 is Central CX.

personas.name: Capability Leader (SEO / Creative / Editorial)
personas.summary: You own a capability team end-to-end — utilisation, hiring, quality. You see every deal that uses your capability and can rebalance your people across them.
daily: Open Home — the Capability Leader Dashboard shows your team's utilisation distribution and a leaderboard of deals by RGY.
Staffing -> People view, filtered to your capability. Red bars need work assigned, yellow bars need work taken off.
Approve / decline staffing requests routed to you.
People Ops: hiring gaps and TBH (To Be Hired) tracker.

modules.name: Custom Dashboard
steps: Team Utilisation chart: stacked by person, showing % allocated this week.
Deals by RGY: every deal your team touches, grouped by health. Click any to drill in (read-only view of the deal).

modules.name: Staffing — your team
steps: On any staffing request routed to you (bell icon), click Approve / Reject. Approval forwards to Central CX for final lock.
From the People view, click a person to see their allocation across all deals. Use this to identify who you can pull off a deal that's wrapping up.

modules.name: Deals (read-only)
steps: You can open any deal your team appears on. RGY, MBR, Staffing tabs are visible but not editable.
Use comments to flag risks to the VSD.

modules.name: People Ops
steps: Manage your capability membership (auto-seeded from role_category).
Mark people as TBH (open req), Leaving, or Active. The platform uses this for capacity forecasting.

cans: See every deal your capability touches
Manage your team in People Ops
cants: Edit deal fields, financials, RGY, MBR
See deals that don't use your capability
faq: A deal isn't showing under my team.

Capability access is granted via staffing_assignments. If no one from your capability is staffed on the deal yet, you won't see it. Wait for the BOPM to raise a request, or ask the VSD to staff one of yours.

personas.name: Capability Member (IC — Individual Contributor)
personas.summary: You're an IC — designer, writer, SEO analyst, strategist. You see only the deals you are personally staffed on, plus your own task board.
daily: Home -> My Tasks. Your Kanban board of work assigned to you, across every deal.
Log time on tasks as you work. Don't end the day with un-tracked hours.
Read RGY status on your deals — if a deal you're on goes Red, expect a sync with the BOPM.

modules.name: Custom Dashboard
steps: My Tasks: 5-column Kanban with time-tracker on every card.
My Deals: read-only cards for each deal you're staffed on. Click into any to see the brief, team, and SoW.

modules.name: Deals (read-only)
steps: Overview tab to read the brief and contract context.
Staffing tab to see who else is on the deal and at what allocation.
Tasks tab — your tasks only are editable; everyone else's are read-only.

cans: Read details of deals you're staffed on
Update your own profile in Settings
faq: I'm assigned tasks but they don't show on Home.
Tasks are only surfaced to Home when the assignee_staffing_person_id matches your profile. If you joined recently, ask Admin to re-link your staffing record via Settings -> Users.

personas.name: Viewer (Read-Only)
personas.summary: You can see everything Admin can see — but cannot edit. Typically Finance, Legal, Founders, or external auditors.
daily: Use the dashboards to monitor org-wide health.
Open any deal to inspect financials, RGY, staffing, MBR.
Export tables to CSV from any module's Columns dropdown.

modules.name: Every module — view mode
steps: Every page loads with a read-only banner at the top.
Edit affordances (pencil icons, inline cells) are hidden or disabled.
Use Cmd+K (Mac) / Ctrl+K (Windows) to jump to any deal or person.

cans: Comment on deals (read-only mode allows comments)
cants: Trigger workflows (staffing requests, RGY updates, MBR uploads)
faq: I need to fix one wrong number for a finance close.
Ask an Admin to make the edit. Viewer is intentionally locked to preserve audit integrity.

modules.name: Clients & Deals
modules.blurb: Unified table grouped by client. Each client expands to show its deals. Click a deal to open the 7-tab Deal Detail: Overview, Financials (with 6 sub-tabs), Staffing, RGY, Tasks, MBR, Documents.
tips: Use the column picker (top right of the table) to show/hide columns.
Soft-deleted deals live in /trash for 30 days.
Composite IDs follow `{PC}_{dealId}` — never edit IDs manually.

modules.name: Staffing & Capacity
modules.blurb: Two views: Deal view (deal cards, expand each to see members) and People view (every person, their utilisation, their deals). The standard work week is 160 hours / month. Allocations are % of full-time.
tips: Lock icon = staffing approved. Locked deals can't be edited until unlocked.
Use the Weekly grid at the bottom of each deal to plan the next 4 weeks.

modules.name: RGY Health
modules.blurb: 8 dimensions per deal (e.g. Delivery, NPS, Renewal Risk, Strategic Alignment). Each gets R/Y/G/Pending. A deal's worst dimension drives its row color. Score = (Green×100 + Yellow×50) / scored dimensions.
tips: Going Green forces the Green-gate validator — all 8 dimensions must justify Green.
Going Red requires the mandatory Issue + Action Plan form.
Pending = unmarked. Click the Pending KPI to drill into untouched deals.

modules.name: MBR Tracker
modules.blurb: One MBR per deal per calendar month. Compliance warnings fire 5 days before month-end. The 'Single source of truth' flag marks the canonical MBR when multiple are uploaded.
tips: Upload deck, notes, and transcript on the MBR card.
Filter by Overdue / Upcoming / Done at the top of the page.

modules.name: People Ops
modules.blurb: Hierarchical tree of the org. Region codes, capability membership, active / TBH / Leaving states. Reporting manager chain is enforced here.
tips: Adding someone here doesn't grant Pepper OS access — that happens via Settings -> Users when they first sign in.

modules.name: Settings
modules.blurb: Personal preferences (theme, default currency), Users & Roles, Access Controls, and Integrations (Slack, Google Calendar, FX rate provider).
tips: FX rate is set centrally in Integrations and used everywhere INR<->USD shows up.
Use 'View As' in Users to preview the app as any role.
